description: Large Scale Topo Bridge Tunnel (Polygon) (LGATE-137) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. A structure erected over a depression or obstacle, or an underground or an underwater passage, open at both ends, designed to carry traffic. Multiple points that describe the feature’s perimeter. NOTE: Landgate no longer maintains large scale topographic features. The large scale topographic data capture programme ceased in 2016. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are Bridge, BridgePad, Tunnel, landgate, largescale. It offers 9 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
